The `"./*": "./src/*.ts"` wildcard means `@paperclipai/adapter-utils/executor` and `@paperclipai/adapter-utils/local-executor` are already accessible as subpath imports — just like `@paperclipai/adapter-utils/server-utils`. So the new files are automatically exported via the wildcard.

However, the task says to "Export both from `packages/adapter-utils/src/index.ts`". Since the index.ts is browser-safe and both new modules import from `server-utils.ts` (which uses `node:child_process`), I must export only the types (not the runtime values) from the root index, and note that the runtime implementations are available via subpath. Let me re-read the instructions carefully:

The spec says: "Export both from `packages/adapter-utils/src/index.ts` (read it first to see what it currently exports)."

The current `index.ts` already has a comment: "Keep the root adapter-utils entry browser-safe because the UI imports it. The sandbox callback bridge stays available via its dedicated subpath export." — and exports `SandboxCallbackBridgeRequest` etc. as `type` only from `sandbox-callback-bridge.js`.

The safe pattern is to export the types only from the root index, matching the existing pattern. The concrete implementations (`createLocalCommandExecutor`) are only reachable via the subpath (`@paperclipai/adapter-utils/local-executor`), which is already wired up by the `"./*"` wildcard.
